## New

- **Files sent together ask once.** With "Ask before receiving files" on, sending several files at once shows one Accept / Decline ("Pixel wants to send 5 files", "a.jpg and 4 more · 23 MB") instead of one per file. Works PC → phone, phone → PC, PC → PC and phone → phone. Both sides need this version; older apps still ask per file.
- **macOS: send from Finder.** Right-click files → Quick Actions → "Dotlink: <device>", one item per paired phone or linked PC, plus "Every connected device" when there are several. The list follows pairing, unpairing and renaming. If it doesn't show, turn it on in System Settings → Keyboard → Keyboard Shortcuts → Services → Files and Folders.
